scores.tell: Magenta/red background with blue and gold drums is rich and related; hero and background both loud, but fits real cards' saturated backdrops.
Blue-on-blue: navy lamp against cyan-blue background has low hue separation; the red/yellow/cyan lights form a loud multi-accent cluster.
Neon pink/cyan jellyfish glow on electric blue-violet rays; fully pushed to pure hue with no natural local color or neutral rest, and has glow instead of the game's matte color.
Red/yellow/orange umbrella on cyan rings is a clean complementary hero and background; matches real cards' flat saturated palette. Silver pole gives a neutral.
Navy lamp on teal-blue background is low contrast in hue; dark gray truss is muted. The accent lights are fine.

Red-to-orange gradient wall plus peach floor pulls the card warm; peach floor is pale and washed out. Green chair against the warm backdrop is good, but the backdrop is not a real-card-style flat colour.
Pale lavender-white unit on pastel green stripes is washed-out low chroma; the hero barely separates from the background and the blue airflow is a faint pastel streak. Reals are bolder.
Natural brown/red leather and tan wood against bright cyan sky; very close to the grade-5 saddle palette, with a believable complementary pairing.
Blue base, white/red dish, and sand/sky are believable local colors; sand is slightly pale and sky blue is a bit generic. Otherwise on-style.
Navy calculator with cyan keys on yellow pi pattern; strong complement and cream keys give a neutral rest. The orange pattern is slightly loud.
